sso_guide.title: How to set up Microsoft Entra ID
sso_guide.dialog_title: Connect Microsoft Entra ID, step by step
sso_guide.intro: You need an Entra ID administrator account. The whole procedure takes about five minutes.
sso_guide.s1: Open the **Microsoft Entra admin center** > **App registrations** > **New registration**.
sso_guide.s2: Under **Supported account types** choose **Single tenant only**.
sso_guide.s3: Set the Redirect URI platform to **Web**, paste the URI shown below and click **Register**.
sso_guide.s5: In **Certificates & secrets** create a **Client secrets** entry and copy its **Value**.
sso_guide.b1: Open the Microsoft Entra admin center, go to **App registrations** and click **New registration**.
sso_guide.t2: Name the app and choose Single tenant
sso_guide.b2: Enter a name your colleagues will recognise, for example **AION Agent**. Under **Supported account types** select **Single tenant only**: the first option, followed by the name of your organisation. Do not choose the multitenant or personal-account options. AION signs users in against your own directory only.
sso_guide.b3: In **Redirect URI (optional)** choose the **Web** platform and paste the address below. Then click **Register**.
sso_guide.cap1: Registration form: the numbers match the steps above.
sso_guide.t4: Copy the application and tenant IDs
sso_guide.b4: The new app opens on **Overview**. Copy **Application (client) ID** and **Directory (tenant) ID** and paste them into the matching fields of this page.
sso_guide.b5: In the app menu open **Certificates & secrets**, select the **Client secrets** tab and click **New client secret**. Add a description such as AION, keep the suggested expiry (180 days) or pick another one, then click **Add**.
sso_guide.cap2: Certificates & secrets: add the client secret.
sso_guide.b6: Copy the **Value** column right away: Microsoft shows it only once. Do not copy **Secret ID**. Paste it into the **Client secret** field of this page.
sso_guide.warn: When the secret expires, Microsoft sign-in stops working until you create a new one and enter it here. Note the expiry date in your calendar.
sso_guide.b7: Click **Save and verify with my account** and sign in with your Microsoft account in the pop-up. When the configuration is validated, use **Set as default** to make Microsoft the sign-in method.
sso_guide.shots_note: Screenshots come from the Italian portal; labels follow the language of your Microsoft account.
sso_guide.alt1: Microsoft Entra: Register an application form
sso_guide.alt2: Microsoft Entra: Add a client secret panel
sso_guide.btn_save_verify: Save and verify with my account

sso_guide_google.title: How to set up Google sign-in
sso_guide_google.dialog_title: Connect Google sign-in, step by step
sso_guide_google.intro: You need a Google account that can create projects in Google Cloud. The procedure takes about ten minutes.
sso_guide_google.s1: Open the Google Cloud Console and create a project (or pick an existing one).
sso_guide_google.s2: In **Google Auth Platform** click **Get started** and fill in app name, support email, audience and contact email.
sso_guide_google.s3: Open **Clients** > **Create client** and choose **Web application** as application type.
sso_guide_google.s4: Paste the URI shown below into **Authorized redirect URIs** and click **Create**.
sso_guide_google.s5: Copy **Client ID** and **Client secret**: the secret is shown only once.
sso_guide_google.b1: Open the Google Cloud Console and create a new project with **New project**, or select one you already use. Enter a **Project name** such as **AION Agent** and click **Create**.
sso_guide_google.b2: Search for **Google Auth Platform** in the top search bar and open it. If it says the platform is not configured yet, click **Get started**.
sso_guide_google.b3: Type an app name (for example **AION Agent**) and choose the **User support email**. Users see them on the Google consent screen. Click **Next**.
sso_guide_google.b4: Pick **Internal** if your company uses Google Workspace: only your organisation's accounts can sign in and no Google verification is needed. Pick **External** otherwise. In that case the app starts in test mode and only users you add under **Audience** > Test users can sign in. Click **Next**.
sso_guide_google.t5: Add a contact email and finish
sso_guide_google.b5: Enter an email address in **Contact information** and click **Next**. Then accept the Google API Services user data policy, click **Continue** and finally **Create**.
sso_guide_google.b6: In the left menu open **Clients** and click **Create client**.
sso_guide_google.b7: Choose **Web application** as application type and give the client a name, for example **AION Agent**. Under **Authorized redirect URIs** click **Add URI**, paste the address below and click **Create**.
sso_guide_google.t8: Copy Client ID and Client secret
sso_guide_google.b8: Google shows both values in the **OAuth client created** dialog. Copy them and paste them into **Client ID** and **Client secret** on this page.
sso_guide_google.warn: The client secret cannot be shown again after you close the dialog. If you lose it, you must create a new one from the client page.
sso_guide_google.b9: Click **Save and verify with my account** and sign in with your Google account in the pop-up. When the configuration is validated, use **Set as default** to make Google the sign-in method.
sso_guide_google.c2: Google Auth Platform overview: start the configuration.
sso_guide_google.c3: App information: app name and support email.
sso_guide_google.c4: Audience: Internal for Workspace, External otherwise.
sso_guide_google.c6: Accept the policy, continue and create.
sso_guide_google.c8: Client form: type, name and redirect URI.
sso_guide_google.c9: OAuth client created: copy both values (hidden here).

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long old conversations are kept before they are cleaned up.
retention.interval_hint: How often the cleanup job runs.
retention.hard_hint: Off: conversations are archived and can be restored. On: they are erased with no way back.
retention.summary_off: Cleanup is off. Conversations are kept forever.
retention.summary_soft: Conversations older than {{days}} days are archived and can be restored.
retention.summary_hard: Conversations older than {{days}} days are erased permanently.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Which files the agent can read and write, and which commands it can run.
sandbox.dev_hint: Permissive. Wide file access and common tools for local work.
sandbox.prod_hint: Strict. Only the workspace and a short list of commands.
sandbox.readonly_note: This template is read-only. Copy it to a custom policy to change it.
sandbox.disabled_note: The sandbox is off: tools are not restricted by file or command rules. The policy file is

admin_feedback.privacy: Aggregate counts of the ratings users leave in chat. Message content, comments and who rated stay private.
